reading_scope.libbrecht2013: Sections 4.3-4.4 and 5; Figure 5 forcing and capillary comparison. Independent event/FV implementation, not original source code.
reading_scope.libbrecht2015_surface: Sections 2-3: accessible-kink exponential rule, n_SD=x_s/a in pixels, top-terrace exclusion, neighbor weight g=1/sqrt(N), and grid limitations.
reading_scope.nelson_swanson2019: Introduction, section 4.3, Appendix A and Appendix B6 read; Appendix A equations visually checked. Remaining morphology catalogue read selectively, not a complete independent review.
reading_scope.miyamoto2022: Methods, results 3.1-3.3 and conclusions read; equations for beta and kappa and their units visually checked on manuscript PDF pages 13 and 17. Supporting information read, including Figure S5 discussion and Table S1.
reading_scope.zhao2026: Publisher-hosted Figshare abstract/metadata and entire four-page supporting PDF read. Main-paper PDF retrieval returned HTTP 403; detailed methods and the pressure-dependence data remain unexamined.
reading_scope.kelly_boyer2014: Algorithm and concluding discussion inspected, including constant-alpha supersaturation scaling. No calibrated mass-plus-axes Earth comparison or original executable implementation identified in this targeted inspection.
reading_scope.tan2021_lbm: Introduction, section 3.2 and conclusions inspected. Flow/phase/species numerical controls and qualitative crystal photographs do not establish joint mass/axis validation for the present warm-column case.

adjoining_transport.mechanism: Molecules migrate over an adjoining facet edge to a thin growing front; distinct from intrafacet terrace completion.
adjoining_transport.simple_flux_ratio: F_AST/F_direct = n*x_s/t before bulk-diffusion feedback, for an absorbing rough front and no edge barrier.
adjoining_transport.uncertainty: The Figure 6 fit uses an unmeasured front-height profile. Historical basal migration estimates of micrometres and the later nanometre-scale reinterpretation disagree; prism migration length is not measured here.

prism_steps.ambient: pure nitrogen, approximately one atmosphere; substrate-supported prism faces
prism_steps.limits: Low-supersaturation spiral steps. The authors report that inferred normal rates do not explain the temperature habit changes; basal spacing is often inconsistent with the simple BCF picture. The full kappa range is not an error bar or a temperature fit.

nitrogen_pressure.limits: Abstract-level pressure result with supporting-video context; no universal whole-crystal multiplier, temperature law or lunar attachment law is inferred.

model_status: Conditional diagnostic hypotheses only. No external full papers or videos are redistributed; bytes remain in ignored research/runs.
unresolved: Zhao et al. 2026 main paper returned HTTP 403; the supporting PDF does not resolve the missing main methods.
No validated autonomous warm-crystal mass and axis trajectory has been established.
No original complete executable Libbrecht cellular-automaton implementation was found in the inspected papers and targeted searches.
